source_read: Pilpel nutrition calculator https://www.pilpel.co.uk/nutrition/ (page sha256 d39ae852af6f70c62e280f113a380f931b833dfb7ed1a5426426ebe7e732f022, no date shown; 18 ingredients in Bread, Falafel, Salad, Sauces, Toppings); locations page https://www.pilpel.co.uk/locations/ (7 London sites); robots.txt disallows only /wp/wp-admin/
not_verifiable: whether the figures are current (the page carries no date); the Falafel (4 balls) row prints 105.68 kcal with 1.91 g fat for a deep-fried item, copied as printed
notes: Extractor reads the hidden value spans by their element ids (value-<ingredient>-kcal, -carbohydrates, -protein, -fat, -saturates, -salt). Second read by another method: the page flattened to plain text, each ingredient's name followed by its eight printed figures in column order (kcal, carbohydrates, protein, fat, saturates, calcium, iron, salt) and compared positionally with items.csv: 18 of 18 rows, 0 differences. The calculator's own script (pilpel-nutrition.js) only sums the ticked ingredients; the meal choices change nothing, so no finished-meal figure exists and none is made. No allergen information is published.
